messages.subject: Project Lumen - Term Sheet for company sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Our client has approved the attached term sheet. Subject to contract as usual, but the binding provisions (confidentiality, the 45-day exclusivity, costs) are intended to bite on signature. Grateful if you could take your client and the founders through it - we'd like signature by the lapse date of 8 December.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Rachel
